summary: community.general deprecated the hipchat callback plugin because the service is discontinued, for removal in community.general 10.0.0.
questions: Is the hipchat callback still supported?

answer_card.title: hipchat callback deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: The **hipchat** callback plugin is deprecated (service discontinued, self-hosted EOL since 2020) and will be removed in **community.general 10.0.0**. Remove it from `callbacks_enabled`.
